title: Anchor a hinged panel and verify its opening direction
applicability: Use for hinged lids, panels or hatches when the same pivot must stay engaged through a defined opening range. Use complementary hinge leaves with a defined axis.
steps: Mount the fixed leaf on the frame. Build the moving leaf, panel and trim together in a separate LegoBuild so their full shape is present during trial.

Call find_connection_candidates on the fixed leaf with intent rotate, the complete hatch as content, its MotionRange, and an opening_toward direction. Set opening_point to a point on the panel away from the pivot.

Use trial_connections with the frame in place. Check the closed alignment and opening clearance, then place_connection with a passing candidate. If none pass, inspect the implicated parts and sample poses before adjusting the frame or mount.
expected: The flat panel clears the crate wall, rises 60 degrees with the moving leaf, and stays attached at seven samples.

sources.author: Carlos Antelo
sources.title: Openable cabin roof study
sources.adaptation: Reference only. The cabin roof study suggested demonstrating the fixed side separately from the moving cover. The BrickWright guidance and example are original.
